# WA2 · Khung · CSKH (trang chủ CSKH hôm nay)

Group **WA · Khung & điều hướng** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`(app shell)`) · account `care-maianh`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/staff-context.js#pages`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#shell`
- The shell is drawn once by `clinic.js › shell(content)`: `.sidebar` (menu filtered by `PemaStaff.allowed(page)`), `.topbar` (breadcrumbs, demo account picker, global search, bell, reset), then the page body.
- `staff-context.js › home()`: care lands on `crm`, accountant on `cashier`, everyone else on `dashboard`.
- Inventory note: Role shell: 4 nav items (schedule, patients, crm, guide), lands on crm. The doctor shell is WB2, the owner shell is WA1.
- Shown with account `care-maianh`; the screen is part of the shell or an overlay (no page key).
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"wait":".sidebar"}; it must show "CSKH hôm nay".

## Business rules
- The account picker is a demo identity boundary, "NOT authentication or production RBAC" (header comment of `staff-context.js`).

## Differences from the app design
- The canvas top bar always draws the bell; the old web shows it for owner and doctor only (care sees the finance link but no bell). Template change needed, see the W3b-WA report.

## Gotchas
- Role and page are kept in `sessionStorage` (`pema-staff`); a fresh browser context always starts as `owner-tam` unless `?staff=<id>` is in the URL.
- Care sees 4 menu items only (Điều phối lịch, Tìm bệnh nhân, CSKH hôm nay, Hướng dẫn).
- The care shell keeps the finance link "Tài chính đã đồng bộ" (old shot) although care has no finance page.
- The landing page "CSKH hôm nay" is drawn in full by group WD (WD1); WA2 draws only its heading and the four KPI tiles for context, with demo numbers from the canvas.
